S25 is cut ([H]): S26 starts in its slot and the montage gets the time. S19c is a close crop of S19's plate (an L extra) on 'Well, we don't know a thing about it', cutting to the full angle on 'don't you ask us'. Before the song: the S01 cold open (the hook from the final chorus on the with-fallback master, no G pass). Inside the 13.3 s intro: S02 (title card) and S03 (the Suno screen, [H] capture) ahead of S04's tail. After the song: S34 (the spectrogram with its line over it), S35 ([H] capture), S36 (the fact card) and the human's closing note to vote, over a low hum that starts under the outro. Pictures are the approved picks (config/v_picks.json, l_picks.json, l.json extra, the G outputs); the stage is the take x 1.5 (1920x1056), filled to 1920x1080.
